CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Papigator** – a self-hosted document archive for families: scan or upload letters, invoices and contracts, get them OCR'd and searchable in seconds, with optional local AI (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server) for titles, senders, dates, deadlines and tags. Your documents stay on your own server.
This repository ships the Papigator server (AGPL-3.0). Questions and bug reports: GitHub issues.
